test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 15th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Convert the following sentence from passive to active voice:The delegates were being informed about the policy by senior officials.

options.text: Senior officials were informing the delegates about the policy.
Senior officials had informed the delegates.
The delegates were informed by officials.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the object of the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The delegates were being informed about the policy by senior officials."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the agent "senior officials" as the subject of the sentence.
 
• Change the passive verb form "were being informed" to the active verb form "were informing".
 
• Ensure the object "the delegates" and the additional information "about the policy" remain in the correct position for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Senior officials were informing the delegates about the policy."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Senior officials had informed the delegates." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
 
• **Option 3: **"The delegates were informed by officials." – This is still in the passive voice.
 
• **Option 4: **"Officials were informing delegates." – Missing details and incorrect structure.
